summary: The note describes Agni-VI, reported to be the latest and most advanced version in the Agni missile series. Sources say it may carry up to 10 MIRV warheads with a strike range of 8,000 km to 12,000 km, though DRDO has refused to confirm the range. A senior DRDO scientist described it as sleeker, easily transportable and readily deployable, able to launch from both submarines and land-based launchers.
one_line: Agni-VI is reported to be the most advanced Agni missile, possibly carrying 10 MIRV warheads with an 8,000–12,000 km range.
key_facts: Agni-VI is reported to be the latest and most advanced version among the Agni missiles.
According to sources, Agni-VI is likely to carry up to 10 MIRV warheads.
Agni-VI is said to have a strike range of 8,000 km to 12,000 km.
DRDO has refused to confirm the Agni-VI missile's range.
A senior DRDO scientist was quoted as saying the new generation Agni-VI missile will be sleeker.
The senior DRDO scientist said the new generation Agni-VI missile would be easily transportable.
The senior DRDO scientist said the new generation Agni-VI missile would be readily deployed.
Agni-VI will have the capability to be launched from submarines.
Agni-VI will have the capability to be launched from land-based launchers.
